name: PrimalVR
summary:
PrimalVR is a fast-paced multiplayer VR party game where up to 16 players compete through 3 chaotic rounds to see who comes out on top.

Run, climb, dodge, survive, and outplay other players across a growing collection of unique maps and game modes. Every round brings new challenges, unexpected moments, and opportunities to knock out the competition.
